decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The site shall only be used as a petrol filling station, and no part shall be used for the sale, display, or repair of vehicles.

Condition : 3 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 4 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing No. KDRB/05 (K) shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.

Condition : 6 - The sales building hereby approved shall only be used ancillary to the main petrol filling station use.  It shall include no more than 66sq.m of retail floor space and shall also include specific facilities for providing light refreshment for the users of the petrol filling station.
description: Demolition of existing building and canopy and erection of a new sales building, canopy forecourt with associated facilities incorporating parking and repositioning of underground tanks.
